user.title: Add an app
user.description: Show an app's web page as a Home Assistant sidebar panel. Home Assistant fetches the page from the app, so the app only has to be reachable from Home Assistant, not from your browser.

data.title: Sidebar title
data.persist_login: Remember the app's login in Home Assistant

data_description.slug: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. It becomes the panel's address (a slug of music becomes /proxy-music) and can't be changed later.
data_description.url: Where Home Assistant reaches the app, such as http://music-assistant:8095 or http://192.168.1.20:8095.
data_description.require_admin: Leave on unless every Home Assistant user should be able to open this app.
data_description.persist_login: Log in to the app once and stay logged in on every device. Everyone who can open the panel shares that login.

data_description.keep_prefix: Turn on for an app that is set up to live under that path. Most apps expect to be at /.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only matters for an https address. Turn off for an app with a self-signed certificate.
data_description.headers: Sent with every request to the app, one per line, such as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN.
data_description.local_storage: Written to the browser before the app loads, one per line, such as ma_access_token: YOUR_TOKEN. Anyone who can open the panel can read them.

reconfigure.title: Change the app
reconfigure.description: Change how this app is reached and shown. The slug stays the same.

error.invalid_slug: Use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores
error.slug_taken: Another app already uses this slug
error.invalid_title: Enter a title for the sidebar
error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// address, without a query string
error.invalid_headers: Extra request headers must be lines of name: value, with plain header names and no line breaks in the values
error.invalid_local_storage: Browser storage entries must be lines of key: value
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant can't reach the app at that address
error.certificate: The app's SSL certificate can't be verified. Turn off certificate verification under Advanced if it is self-signed.
